old_source_cause_experiment.evidence_supported_conclusion: Both saved failures arise in the Keep evidence local-mode search. The final BFGS ascent has predicted density gain around 1e-12, while nearby deterministic value evaluations differ at that scale. A same-density full-score Newton step reduces the residual to far below 1e-6 despite a rounded objective decrease. The existing 100*gtol entry gate excludes that successful final score solve. No unavailable optimizer line, iteration exhaustion, unstable physical branch or score-sign defect is needed to reproduce these two stops.
old_source_cause_experiment.no_unsupported_large_term_claim: Observed log body densities are order 1e2, not 1e8. The measurements show a local function-value precision limit relative to the tiny remaining gain; they do not uniquely isolate its rounding source.
limitations: The cloned whole-event numerical recovery is not a production implementation or a resumed reaching demonstration.
Local Laplace evidence still does not certify the global evidence mass.
No change to stiffness/transform candidate laws or observation data was made.

final_source_original_events_replay.updated_finite_quality_semantics: A finite optimizer iterate is used in the local-mode Laplace formula with its residual/success reported; stationarity is not required. The unmodified formula does not include a linear-score correction and is not an exact nonstationary quadratic integral.

factor_identity_difference.reason: marker_board._project_central added diagnostic record fields and revised approximation prose. The board component signature hashes the whole record, so board_adf labels changed. Stiffness factor fingerprints include those child labels.
factor_identity_difference.verification: For every historical factor through the formerly failed event, substituting only old labels in the new immutable candidate bytes reconstructs the exact old SHA256. Full 66D means/covariances, weights/logweights, reference IDs and projected numerator arrays match byte-for-byte. Runtime results are retained with their actual new labels and IDs.

final_source_original_events_replay.limitation: Offline replay of the actual failed events and one following effective sensor event. It establishes continued posterior/K updates on these original observations and ledger; it does not establish completion, reaching performance, or success of a new live run.
